mechanism: Both drugs can cause neurological adverse effects and renal impairment; zoledronic acid may increase seizure risk in susceptible patients, while levetiracetam metabolism may be affected by renal function changes induced by zoledronic acid.
action: Monitor renal function regularly, assess for increased seizure activity or neurological symptoms, and ensure adequate hydration during zoledronic acid infusions; adjust levetiracetam dosing if renal function declines.
